_: What this game is a slice of. Every stage of the pipeline reads this file and nothing hard-codes any of it — see pipeline/slice.py. Widening the slice is an edit here and a re-bake, never a code change.

regions._bounds: x lo, x hi, y lo, y hi. Measured, not chosen: `npm run measure` takes the bounding box of every map chunk the client labels area 12, which is Elwynn Forest, and prints these four numbers.
